newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai non-life insurance licences ready by March.
newsitem.headline: Thai non-life insurance licences ready by March.

text.p: Thailand is likely to be ready to issue new non-life insurance licences to applicants by March while a longer time would be needed to give out new life insurance licences, a senior official said on Thursday.

Pridiyathorn Devakula, chairman of a commerce ministry panel considering applications for the licences, said eight out of the 66 applicants shortlisted for new life and non-life insurance firms had withdrawn.
No reasons were given as to why the eight applicants had withdrawn.
Pridiyathorn did not say how many licences would be issued but industry executives expect up to 30 new licences will be granted by the government.
